events.name: sliding_window.reserve.first
events.assertion: first reserve admits estimate=4 with usage=4, remaining=6, active=1, keys=1

events.name: sliding_window.reserve.second
events.assertion: second reserve admits and leaves two tokens

events.name: sliding_window.reserve.denied
events.assertion: third reserve is denied without creating another active reservation

events.name: sliding_window.reconcile.refund
events.assertion: reconcile applies a two-token refund

events.name: sliding_window.reconcile.duplicate
events.assertion: duplicate reconcile is a no-op

events.name: sliding_window.reserve.after_refund
events.assertion: refund makes room for one further reservation

events.name: sliding_window.reconcile.overage
events.assertion: reconcile applies a two-token overage

events.name: sliding_window.reconcile.equal
events.assertion: equal actual usage settles the final active reservation

invariants.name: sliding_window.fingerprint.canonical_budget_order_and_estimate_exclusion
invariants.assertion: budget order and per-request estimate are excluded from the persistent semantic fingerprint, so equivalent writers share one budget

invariants.name: sliding_window.mixed_configuration_preserves_long_window_history
invariants.assertion: the mismatched short-window writer is rejected without deleting settled history, and the owning long-window writer remains denied

invariants.name: token_bucket.mixed_configuration_preserves_slow_refill_state
invariants.assertion: the mismatched fast-refill writer is rejected without shortening depleted state, which remains enforced after 1.2 seconds
